summary: Authored the granular vasculature as 39 zero-payload course records and a measured surface-projection pipeline. (1) RECORDS: src/data/structures/vasculature-courses.json (NEW, 39 records) covers the MCA insular segment + superior/inferior terminal trunks + 4 named cortical branches + 4 M4 named branches (prefrontal/precentral/central/anterior-parietal), the ACA pericallosal/callosomarginal/frontopolar/orbitofrontal, the PCA parieto-occipital/calcarine/anterior+middle+posterior temporal/splenial, the perforators (lateral LSA group + 4 chains, medial LSA/Heubner group + 2 chains, PCA thalamogeniculate, PCA posteromedial-central/thalamoperforating, pontine perforators), the SCA lateral/medial/vermian branches, the AICA labyrinthine artery, both PICA segments (tonsillomedullary, telovelotonsillar) and the anterior spinal artery. Each carries region 'vasculature', kind 'vessel', parent + parentArtery links, function, territory[], supply[] (only where the syndrome card names the true cause), clinical items and refs; all 39 ids are registered FIRST in src/data/taxonomy.json (248 -> 287 rows, 14 -> 53 vessel rows, 0 registry-only rows) and every id has a curated entry in src/data/webRefs.ts (vessel kind has no automatic fallback). (2) MEASURED GEOMETRY: a hand-written GLB reader + exact nearest-point-on-triangle probe in .dsh-scratch/vasc-course-probe (lib/probe.mjs, run.mjs, final.mjs, out/final.md) read the committed meshes; every course's origin is a literal committed parent-mesh vertex (M1 superior wall [15.786,11.967,24.920], ACA A1-A2 junction, P1/P2 vertices, basilar bottom, SCA/AICA/PICA/vertebral origins) and 67 waypoints are nearest-triangle projections onto the committed envelopes (ctx-hemisphere-l/r for cortical branches, ctx-pons-surface, ctx-midbrain-surface, ctx-cerebellum-l, ctx-medulla-surface), placed at Q = P + n̂·(tubeRadius + 0.15 au) with the residual and placed point stored per waypoint. Radii are calibreMm/2.4 at 1 au = 1.2 mm from stated calibres (0.8/1.0/1.2/2.0 mm); every waypoint is inside CLIP_BOUNDS. (3) LENTICULOSTRIATES: the two red ellipsoids are replaced by two authored group courses plus six individual chains (4 lateral to the putamen at r=0.333 au, 2 medial/Heubner to the caudate at r=0.417 au), each running from the committed M1 superior-wall vertex through the anterior perforated substance (projected, residual 0.018-1.456 au) into the basal ganglia, with terminal grazes 0.02-0.30 au from the target mesh; the ellipsoid record keys on the runtime id vasc-lenticulostriate-arteries, whose single authored body stays in src/data/structures/vasculature.json (outside this task's write scope), so this file authors its two children and its group children do not duplicate it. (4) new gate scripts/verify/vasc-courses.mjs: 2171 assertions, 0 failures, exit 0 - it re-parses the committed GLBs, cross-checks its accelerated nearest-surface search against an exhaustive pass over every triangle (24 probes, all exact), re-derives every stored residual and offset rule from the mesh bytes, asserts 39/39 ids registered, every course >= 3 waypoints inside CLIP_BOUNDS, mirror consistency for every paired course (worst delta 1.48 au, tolerance 1.6 au because the two committed hemispheres are independently decimated), parent/territory/supply resolution, the lenticulostriate fix, the radius table with its mm source, and zero new payload; it prints the radius table, the mirror table and the per-surface triangle counts. VERIFIED: npm run validate 0 errors/0 warnings; npm run check exit 0; npm run build exit 0; verify:pipeline (138/138 parts, 599,204 tris), verify:plane 10827, verify:somatotopy 45/45, verify:cortical-lobes 564/564, verify:pip-contract 187/187, verify:division-toggles 251/251, verify:audit-checks 92/92, verify:closure-bite, verify:boundary-contract 22/22, verify:a11y-contract 38/38, verify:budget-report (13.82 MiB <= 14 MiB, headroom 0.18), verify:cranial-nerves 451/451, verify:nerve-kind, verify:cranial-nerve-courses 220/220, verify:view-filter-consistency all exit 0; the sibling render gate scripts/verify/vessel-render.mjs (not mine) passes 75/75 over my data: 40 courses, 77 tubes, 0 placement blobs. TWO REDS I CANNOT FIX INSIDE MY WRITE SCOPE, both for the reviewer: (a) scripts/verify/cranial-nerve-render.mjs section 6 asserts partsForCanvas().length === SECTION_PARTS + SECTION_NERVE_PARTS and now finds 190 = 138 committed + 12 nerve + 40 vessel procedural parts - re-point it to name the vessel term, this is the v17 data landing, not a regression; (b) verify:area-toggles was already red before this run (its lane 9 expects 12 registryNerveParts where the shipped mirror produces 24) and it now also sees the 40 vessel parts. imaging-fit cannot run in this sandbox (spawnSync node EPERM at scripts/verify/imaging-fit.mjs:92, the same confined-sandbox boundary the plan documents for verify:anatomy) and touches none of my files. DEVIATIONS FROM THE PLAN, all reported rather than silently filled: the posterior spinal artery is NOT authored (the plan itself omits it: no BP3D element, no committed envelope to hug), and instead of the plan's MCA M4 subset I authored the four brief-named M4 cortical branches plus the two plan-named trunk records, and I added the brief-named pericardial/pontine perforator record the plan omitted - each of those records states in its anchorNote what the archive does and does not carry. The plan put the vessel table in src/geometry/curves.ts, which is in no task's write scope; the sibling render task created src/geometry/vasculature-courses.ts instead and consumes this JSON via import.meta.glob, merging by id - verified by running their gate. package.json untouched; the npm script line the integrator should add is "verify:vasc-courses": "node scripts/verify/vasc-courses.mjs".
